critical_code_review_comments: CSS fix implementation is clean and scoped: mobile-fix only overrides the .tbl-cargos-wrap + table.tbl-cargos, leaving other tables' block layout intact.
Hint text delivered via ::before pseudo-element correctly hidden on desktop (content:none) and shown on mobile — good separation of concerns.
No body-level horizontal overflow introduced by the wide (900px) table because overflow-x:auto is on the wrapper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The tbl-cargos mobile CSS fix in /app/frontend/public/index.html is fully verified and working. The wrapper div.tbl-cargos-wrap with overflow-x:auto plus table.tbl-cargos with min-width:900px keeps the concurso jobs table horizontally scrollable inside its container on mobile without leaking overflow to body. Desktop unaffected. Other tables on same page still stack cell-per-row on mobile as intended.
